main_result: For any symmetric compatibility relation E on supported physical row triples, the Hellinger pair law Pi proportional to sqrt(a_S a_T) has marginal mu with alpha_i<=(1+beta_i)/2, beta_i=Pi(i in S intersect T), and exact determinant/entropy currency G=B_E exp(-H(T|S)). If beta_*<1/2, the sharp weighted third-volume theorem gives ||p_Q||inf <= [3e/((1-2beta_*)sqrt(1+beta_*))] G^(-1/6) and p_Q in C0.
essential_correction: The preceding hoped-for universal extraction of one six-row complement-Hellinger packet is false. The repeated-frame target family A_k has three +1 and three -1 eigenvalues, but every cut and six-row packet has C_R<=8/k^3. Global disjoint-base compatibility aggregation retains exact currency G=1 and gives ||p||inf<=3e.

explicit_target_family.compatibility: row triples paired when intersection size is one

partner_result_applied.application: On dense A_4=[[J_4/10,2H_4],[2H_4,J_4/10]], H_4=I_4-(1/2)11^T, Z=256 and strict h<3/4 support is infeasible; partner theorem gives ||p||inf<=3. Every symmetric triple-pair coupling has beta_*>=1/2 there, so this is exactly the new compiler endpoint.

unresolved_implication: QFORM-COMPATIBILITY-CURRENCY-OR-COMPOUND-HUB-v1: from bare s3(A)>=1 either force a cut and symmetric base compatibility relation with beta_*<1/2 and target-scale G_E=B_E exp(-H(T|S)), or route quantitative failure into completed support-defect / compound-hub / ridge / pair-log / aggregate-square branches without paying an arbitrarily small extra singular direction.
